description: This file defines the `AsyncTimeout` enum providing asynchronous timeout utilities using Swift's concurrency features, including methods `withTimeout` and `withTimeoutMs` for executing async operations with timeout handling.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes an async operation with a specified timeout, cancelling if it exceeds the given time in seconds.

methods.name: withTimeoutMs
methods.description: Executes an async operation with a timeout specified in milliseconds by converting to seconds.
